GDPR is in scope for EU users — standard data processing details will be requested.

Audit log/export requirements (what we need from the vendor):

- Export format: compressed CSV or JSONL with checksums.
- Immutability: we need demonstrable WORM / write-once proof for exported packages and a record of internal append-only logging prior to export.
- Retention: audit teams ask for up to 7 years for certain records; for initial validation, 2 years is acceptable but we need to understand extension options.

I attached our vendor questionnaire — it’s fairly detailed on encryption, key management, and exportability. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide:
1) An API endpoint to request ad-hoc export of admin activity (filtered by timeframe)
2) A verifiable checksum + signed manifest for export bundles

Karthik — quick answers below and I attached a sample export + short process doc. I also flagged a few optional controls you can offer ProspectCo if they need multi-year retention.

Short answers (for the questionnaire):
- Ad-hoc export API: Yes. Endpoint: POST /api/v1/audit/exports (authenticated with service token or OAuth client). Supports filters: timeframe, actor_id, action types, and request_id. Exports produced as compressed JSONL or CSV. Rate limit: default 10 exports/hour (configurable on Dedicated/Private).
- Signed manifest + checksums: Yes. Every export bundle includes a signed manifest.json with SHA256 checksums for each file and an RSA-signed manifest signature (we can provide public key or sign with customer-held key in Private deployments).
- Immutability: Internal event store is append-only; exports are generated from the immutable KV-store snapshot and we support S3 Object Lock (WORM) for customer export buckets. For Hosted customers we can produce a signed chain-of-custody document and timestamped manifest.
- Retention: Default retention for admin logs is 90 days (Hosted). We can offer extended retention to 2+ years on Dedicated/Private or via archiving exports to customer-owned storage. For audit requests requiring 7 years, the recommended approach is periodic export + customer-managed storage or Dedicated contract.
- Chain-of-custody & provenance: Export bundle includes manifest, export request audit record (who requested, when, filters), and a notarized checksum file.

Timeline (recommended):
- Sample CSV & headings: 24–48 hours (attached).
- Ad-hoc export proof-of-concept (signed manifest + sample bundle): 3–7 business days, depending on scope and size of timeframe requested.
- Full package with S3 Object Lock proof and chain-of-custody evidence: ~7–10 business days and may require a short onboarding step for export destination config.

Attachments: redwood-audit-export-sample.csv, audit-extract-process.md

Let me know if you want me to write short answers into the questionnaire PDF directly or if you want to route that through Legal.

—Marissa
